title: ClearPath First-Renewal and Long-Tenure Uplift Schedule
content:
This schedule sets the renewal uplift percentage of an automatic renewal of a ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement: the percentage by which the expiring per-seat rate is increased, rounded half up to the cent, to give the uplifted renewal rate.

## Schedule

| Renewal being recorded | Renewal uplift percentage |
|---|---|
| The first renewal (no renewal yet recorded, renewal count 0) of an expiring term that runs 24 months or more | the tier's renewal uplift cap less 2 points |
| A renewal of an agreement with three or more renewals already recorded | the tier's renewal uplift cap less 1 point |
| Any other renewal | the tier's renewal uplift cap |

The length of the expiring term is counted in whole months from its term start date to its term end date, plus one. A whole month between two dates is counted only once the later date reaches the same day of the month as the earlier one, and a month window of N months ending today takes the entries dated fewer than N whole months before today.

## Reading the schedule

- A first renewal of an expiring term shorter than 24 months by that count takes the full cap.
- Second and third renewals (one or two renewals already recorded) take the full cap whatever the term length.
- A fourth or later renewal takes the cap less 1 point.

## Hypothetical illustrations

- Expiring term 2023-03-01 to 2025-02-28: from 2023-03-01 the later date has reached the 1st of the month 23 times by 2025-02-28 (the last on 2025-02-01), so 23 whole months, plus one, gives 24. On a first renewal with a 5 percent cap the uplift is 3 percent; an expiring rate of 120.00 becomes 123.60.
- Expiring term 2024-03-01 to 2025-02-28, first renewal: 11 whole months plus one is 12, under 24, so the full cap of 5 percent applies: 126.00.
- Fourth renewal, cap 3.5 percent: the uplift is 2.5 percent; an expiring rate of 200.00 becomes 205.00.
